content:
release-manager: Noticed deploy-bot failing to publish the 2026.03.20 images to us-east-1 ECR. Multiple PutImageManifest 429s in the release logs. Can we quick triage?

deploy-bot: [system] publish error: PutImageManifest -> 429 TooManyRequests (retry_count=4). op_id=db-7c1

kate: I see several CI runners hammering the same repo with parallel arch pushes + SBOMs. Likely tripping soft quotas on the registry.

niko: Is diverting to another region an option? We could write the image to us-west-2 and mirror, but CI expects us-east digests for rollout pins.

sam: Product is sensitive about the window. If we divert, we risk a mismatch between canary and global routes. Alternative is to keep canary on last stable digest and try a low-rate manual publish.

infra-bot: Suggested mitigation: throttle publish-runner to N=1 parallel PutImage per repo for large manifests, add exponential backoff with jitter. Will open an infra PR.

release-manager: short plan: 1) pause global rollout 2) pin canary to previous stable digest sha256:aa12bb34 3) attempt manual single-threaded republish from build 2026-03-20-58 4) if publish succeeds but attestation fails, mark as pending and hold rollout.

kate: I can run manual republish. Commands (dry run):

```
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name my-service --image-ids imageTag=2026-03-20-58 --region us-east-1 --output json > manifest.json
# single-threaded push
aws ecr put-image --repository-name my-service --image-tag=2026-03-20-58 --image-manifest file://manifest.json --region us-east-1
```

deploy-bot: [system] action: canary pinned service/my-service-canary -> sha256:aa12bb34. global_rollout_paused=true. audit=pin-20260320-kate

niko: If manual push works, please don't retag the old digest to the new semver tag. Create an explicit pending tag `2026.03.20-pending-sbom` for the new digest so we don't overwrite `latest` or `2026.03.20`.

kate: manual publish ran: first put-image attempts hit a couple 429s, backed off, then succeeded on the third attempt. Manifest push returned 200. Now attempting SBOM/post-attestation.

deploy-bot: [system] attestation upload failed: 413 PayloadTooLarge to attestation endpoint. Fallback_mode=deferred_attestation.

compliance-bot: [system] Deferred attestation requires an exception ticket. Filing exception: EXC-20260320-1. Attach release ticket and expected attestation ETA.

sam: Given deferred attestation, let's keep canary pinned and hold global rollout. Add release note: "Publishing completed to registry but SBOM attestation deferred; canary is on previous stable digest. Full rollout pending compliance exception resolution."

release-manager: Decision: hold the change window and continue business-as-usual for canary. If compliance approves the exception and attestation completes within the window we resume; otherwise we reschedule. Thanks all.

infra-bot: Temporary publish-runner config applied: parallel_puts=1, backoff_initial_ms=500, max_retries=6. Monitoring for 1 hour, will revert if not needed.

kate: created tag `2026.03.20-pending-sbom` on the new digest; did not overwrite semver tag. Command used: aws ecr put-image --repository-name my-service --image-tag=2026.03.20-pending-sbom --image-manifest file://manifest.json

deploy-bot: [system] release window paused. pending_actions=[attestation,compliance_exception]. contact=@compliance-bot for updates.

release-manager: I'll update the release ticket and the customer-facing notes. If attestation lands early we'll flip rollout in the same window, otherwise we'll plan next available window. :calendar:
